results.title: CoolDock Review | Scout Forge
results.content:
### Design & Usability

CoolDock's landing page is genuinely well-crafted: the widget mockups look like real macOS dark-mode UI, typography is disciplined, and the hero CTA is impossible to miss. The visual audit flagged the surreal rock landscape as disconnected from the product and the award badges as too small to read, but the core design work is strong. Usability is where it stumbles — the docs page is a single paragraph and a support email, which is thin for a product with 160 widgets across 20 categories. The changelog shows real iteration (v2.0.7 through v2.1.0 in under two months), and the homepage does a good job showing rather than telling. But a new user hunting for how to configure a specific widget or set up profiles will find nothing beyond the marketing page. [...] CoolDock is a second macOS dock that sits beside your original one and fills it with live widgets — music, weather, todos, calendar, system stats, revenue, GitHub, analytics, and more across 160 widgets in 20 categories. The pitch is clear and the execution is real: the landing page looks polished, the widget mockups are convincing, and the measured speed is excellent (94 mobile, 100 desktop). Security is competent but unaudited, accessibility aces automated checks without documentation, and the docs page is essentially empty. The growth story is the strongest angle — live information widgets are a genuine differentiator against uBar, Sidebar, and DockFix, which all focus on window management. At 0.1 years old with a one-time payment model and a 14-day money-back guarantee, it's an [...] CoolDock is an award-winning second Dock for macOS. It sits beside your original Dock, so nothing about your current setup changes, and gives you a live strip of widgets, apps, folders and quick actions built for the way you actually work. CoolDock brings music, todos, calendar events, weather, search, system stats, quick actions, and more useful widgets into one beautiful live dock. Pick from more than 160 widgets across 20 categories, from clocks and reminders to revenue, AI plan usage, and everyday tools like clipboard, screenshots and AirDrop, and pin the apps, folders and files you reach for most. CoolDock is native, local-first and respects your privacy. It only asks for a macOS permission when a widget needs it. One-time payment, no subscription, 14-day money-back guarantee. Runs

What they are saying is not true I have two air conditioner repair men come in they followed the troubleshooting steps that I was given and the both said the same thing the motor was broken I passed that information on to the company in a email they then wanted me to send a video of the unit as it stops working I did that their response was the light is flashing on the unit I told them right so they could clearly is that the unit was broken after that I sent email asking what were they going to do as of today I have gotten no response I reached out to the company in June we have been going back in forth since the unit was under contract factory warranty until 9/6/24 that was the original date of purchase it they do not make this right I will be filing a small claims suit in the court to get this resolved. I explained the above and was told, by email, "I will have to check with the warehouse workers" about the locking cap coming being packaged with the unit.When I asked about the items listed by the inspector, I was told 'that doesn't involve us'.Since that time, anytime I call I receive a recorded message that states "There is no answer. we add went over this complaint; we understand how frustrating this situation could be for the customer, while communicating with REMOVEDwe had asked for pictures of the board so we can see the capacitors, and the customer just sent pictures of the other side of the board, we want to help the customer since we are honoring the warranty, although warranties have a procedure that needs to be followed, otherwise we are left with no information that our company requires to finalize the dispute. We fully understand that customers want their issues resolved, so we proactively sent out a new outdoor unit, which the customer had no objection to at the time. We cannot do any refunds on units that we not purchased through us and we cannot just give the customer a whole new unit, we have done the best we can with the troubleshooting process.
